items.title: ESP8266 Weather Station and Binary Number Challenge
items.description: An academic connected-object project built with an ESP8266. It reads environmental data from a BME280 sensor, displays the readings on an OLED and a local web server, and includes a binary number challenge: three LEDs show a value in binary. The player reads the LEDs, selects the matching decimal number with the button, checks it on the OLED, and confirms the answer.
items.technologies: ESP8266 · C++ · Arduino · BME280 · SSD1306 OLED · I²C · Wi‑Fi
